title: 🚩 Red Flag Emoji Meaning: Warning Signs in Dating
description: The red flag emoji 🚩 calls out a warning sign, mostly in dating and relationships. Learn the slang, the 🚩🚩🚩 meme format, and its original golf-course use.
summary: The red flag emoji 🚩, officially the triangular flag, marks a warning sign. It is used above all for dating and relationship behavior that suggests trouble ahead, as in “he never asks you questions 🚩.” Less often it keeps its literal jobs: a golf pin, a marker on a map, or a beach hazard flag.
meaning: Calling something a red flag long predates emoji; the phrase has meant a danger signal for generations. The 🚩 emoji simply gave it a keyboard shortcut. Today a single 🚩 after a description says “that would worry me,” and a row of them says “run.” The subject is usually a romantic prospect: someone who is rude to waiters, still lives on their ex's Netflix, or says all their former partners were crazy.

The format exploded in 2021, when a meme spread across Twitter and then everywhere else: a quoted statement followed by a string of flags, such as “I don't really listen to music” 🚩🚩🚩. Brands, sports clubs, and celebrities all joined in. That wave moved the emoji from serious relationship advice into comedy, so a large share of current use is tongue-in-cheek, aimed at harmless preferences like putting ketchup on steak.

The serious meaning never went away. Advice accounts and friends use 🚩 for controlling behavior, love bombing, and other signs of an unhealthy relationship, and the same shorthand now covers job listings, landlords, and business deals. The opposite term, green flag, has no matching emoji, so people write it out or substitute 💚 or ✅. Before the slang took over, the emoji was a plain location and sports marker inherited from Japanese phones.

contexts.label: In dating talk
contexts.body: Group chats dissecting a first date run on 🚩. One flag invites discussion; three or more deliver a verdict. People also apply it to themselves (“my red flag is that I reply in four business days 🚩”), a self-aware confession format that is popular on dating profiles and TikTok.

contexts.label: On TikTok and Instagram
contexts.body: Videos listing “red flags in a partner” or “red flags in a job interview” use 🚩 in captions and on-screen text, often paired with green-flag and beige-flag lists. Comment sections reply with a wall of flags when a storyteller describes something alarming, sometimes without a single word.

contexts.label: At work
contexts.body: In hiring and business contexts, 🚩 flags concerns: a vague salary range, a contract clause, a client who wants everything by Friday. It is informal but widely understood. Note that in some task and email tools a red flag icon just marks an item as important, which is a different convention.

examples.text: He said he “doesn't believe in” apologizing 🚩🚩🚩
examples.meaning: The sender thinks this is a serious warning sign about a date.
Mocking a phrase in a job ad as a sign of a bad workplace.

examples.text: My biggest red flag is that I think I can fix him 🚩
examples.meaning: A joking self-critique about the sender's own dating habits.

examples.text: Tee time 8am, pin's at the back today 🚩⛳
examples.meaning: Literal use for a golf flag.

combos.meaning: The meme format: whatever was just quoted is a major warning sign.
Red flag spotted, time to leave quickly.
Something seems off and the sender is watching closely.

confusedWith.difference: ⛳ shows a red flag planted in a golf green and is used for golf itself. The triangular flag alone has become slang for a warning, so golfers who mean the sport are safer with ⛳.
📍 marks a location. The triangular flag once shared that role, but dropping it next to a place name now risks implying the place is a problem.
⚠️ is a formal caution sign suited to hazards and announcements. The red flag is personal and judgmental: it comments on someone's character or a deal's trustworthiness.

avoid: Do not use it as a neutral bullet point or map pin in messages about a person or company; readers will take it as criticism.
Avoid turning real signs of abuse into a joke format when a friend is describing something that scared them.
design: A small triangular red pennant flies from a thin pole, pointing right on most platforms. Apple, Google, Samsung, and Microsoft all make it red, which is why “red flag emoji” is the name most people search for even though the official name mentions only the shape. Some designs add a base or slight wave to the cloth.

faqs.q: What does 🚩 mean from a girl or a guy?
faqs.a: The same thing from anyone: the sender sees a warning sign in what was just said or described. If it follows something you said about yourself, they are teasing or criticizing you, depending on how many flags and what else they wrote.
Several flags in a row intensify the warning and usually reference the 2021 meme in which a quoted statement is followed by flags. It means “huge red flag,” whether seriously or as a joke.

faqs.q: Is there a green flag emoji?
faqs.a: No. There is no green triangular flag in the emoji set. People express a green flag, meaning a promising sign, with words or with stand-ins such as 💚, ✅, or 🟢.

faqs.q: What was the red flag emoji originally for?
faqs.a: Its official name is triangular flag on post, and it has been in the emoji set since 2010. It was intended as a marker flag of the kind seen on golf courses and maps, not as a symbol of danger.
